whenToUse: Structured filters as chips above tables, boards, calendars and galleries.
Field → condition → value filters with editable chips.
avoidWhen: One or two simple filters — use a Select or Tabs.
Free-text search only — use the table search input.
a11y: Each chip segment is a labelled button; removing a chip is announced.
The add-filter popover is keyboard navigable end to end.
